# S3.4c — the Stage-3 estimator kernel (`hh-analysis`): `ResultsRow → EvalRun` projection, A1 `summarize` / A2 `compare` / A3 `contrast` / A8 `equivalence` / A12 `multiplicity` / transfer rows, the `analysis_report_body/1` contract with deterministic `report_id`, and the store-backed `lab.analysis.analyze` boundary op (R-2.10.4⁰ᵇ)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §6.4 (the analysis/estimator kernel) ·
§2.2 (watermarks) · §8 (reproducibility)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/049_S3.4c__estimator-kernel.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.10.4⁰ᵇ**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s3.4b` (stacked) · **Stage:** 3 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all checks hermetic)
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0280-s3.4c-estimator-kernel-rulings.md`

## Summary

**The kernel is pure over its input record — storage stays at the
boundary.** `hh-analysis` is a new leaf crate: `project` maps a durable
`ResultsRow` plus its `RunManifest`/`LedgerFacts`/task/suite contexts to
the `EvalRun` the `hh-eval` estimators consume — field-by-field, never
guessing (`MissingClusterKey` on a task-less row, `BadField` on an
unknown consumption dimension, `MetricValueKind::Na` carried through
typed, never zeroed). `kernel` dispatches `AnalysisSpec.kind`:
`summarize` (per-cell/per-stratum with `pass^k` detail and per-task
consistency), `compare` (matched-budget paired — `UnmatchedBudget` /
`IncommensurableMatch` / `MissingMatchSpec` refuse typed), `interaction`
(the A3 difference-of-differences `contrast`), `equivalence` (three-
valued, margins only from `PreRegistration` — `NoRegisteredMargins`
otherwise, underlying `CompareOutcome` preserved), and `transfer` rows
(held-out delta, `transfer_ratio`, sign stability + conditionality
region, typed `n/a` when the input delta is unidentified). Non-C0 kinds
refuse `KindNotImplemented` — the S4.3 seam stays honest.

**A12 is a pass, not a kind.** Every produced `ComparisonReport` carries
the sign-flip permutation raw p (exact `2^n` enumeration ≤20 tasks,
deterministic seeded Monte-Carlo above — +1-smoothed, never an
impossible zero), Holm across the pre-registered primary family, BH
q-values across the exploratory remainder, and
`family_size`/`method`/`label` members (additive on `Multiplicity`).
Nothing is suppressed — an exploratory label is a report fact.

**Reports are durable and served, never recomputed.** `report_id =
H(spec_hash ∥ generated_from)` is computable before any estimator runs;
`analyze_and_record` checks the named `analysis_report` doc first and
serves the stored body verbatim on a hit (status derived from that
body). The `AnalysisRecord` lands under `analysis`, the
`analysis_report_body/1` payload under `analysis_report`, and the
`AnalysisReport.result_ref` names it.

**The boundary is records-in/records-out.** `lab.analysis.analyze`
(`labi`, Group L) resolves rows through `ResultsStore` by key or version
id, projects each run's manifest + ledger facts from the durable prefix,
binds `spec_ref` to the registered `hh-experiment/1` doc (design, arms,
pre-registration; named `budget` docs resolve the arm refs), runs the
kernel, and returns `{record, report, body}`. Refusals map typed —
`BadSpec` → `SchemaViolation`, resolution/estimator refusals →
`Refused`.

## Also in this change

- `hh_eval::scorecard::T_CLT` corrected 30→100 — ADR-0158's constant;
  sub-floor cells substitute through `bootstrap_paired` with the
  `substituted{from,to,reason}` record (ADR-0280 D2).
- `hh_eval::stats::permutation_signflip_p` — the ADR-0158 default test.
- `hh_eval::benefits::equivalence_run_full` — additive; `equivalence_run`
  keeps its report-only signature.
- `hh_embed_schema::ops` — `lab.analysis.analyze` flips to implemented;
  schema export + generated client regenerated.
- `AnalysisSpec` += `kind`/`spec_ref`/`label` (CC8 additive; absent
  decodes to `summarize`/`None`/`None`).
